source: openhands.tools.*.definition, read from the pinned agent-server image's PyInstaller PYZ and verified byte-structure-equal to the pinned openhands-tools sdist
caveat: Field sets are read off the constructed pydantic models. Executor implementations, rich, and browser drivers were stubbed inert; logic living in a stubbed dependency is not covered. Modules that failed to execute are listed under `unavailable` and are NOT absent-by-omission.

fields.name: patch
fields.description: Patch content following the '*** Begin Patch' ... '*** End Patch' format as described in OpenAI GPT-5.1 prompting guide.

fields.name: index
fields.description: The index of the element to click (from browser_get_state)

fields.name: new_tab
fields.description: Whether to open any resulting navigation in a new tab. Default: False

fields.name: tab_id
fields.description: 4 Character Tab ID of the tab to close (from browser_list_tabs)

fields.name: extract_links
fields.description: Whether to include links in the content (default: False)

fields.name: start_from_char
fields.description: Character index to start from in the page content (default: 0)

fields.name: include_screenshot
fields.description: Whether to include a screenshot of the current page. Default: False

fields.name: url
fields.description: The URL to navigate to

fields.name: new_tab
fields.description: Whether to open in a new tab. Default: False

fields.name: direction
fields.description: Direction to scroll. Options: 'up', 'down'. Default: 'down'

fields.name: storage_state
fields.description: Storage state dictionary containing 'cookies' and 'origins' (from browser_get_storage)

fields.name: tab_id
fields.description: 4 Character Tab ID of the tab to switch to (from browser_list_tabs)

fields.name: index
fields.description: The index of the input element (from browser_get_state)

fields.name: text
fields.description: The text to type

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Brief explanation of why you need Tom agent consultation

fields.name: use_user_message
fields.description: Whether to consult about the user message (True) or provide custom query (False)

fields.name: custom_query
fields.description: Custom query to ask Tom agent (only used when use_user_message is False)

fields.name: command
fields.description: The commands to run. Allowed options are: `spawn`, `delegate`.

fields.name: ids
fields.description: Required parameter of `spawn` command. List of identifiers to initialize sub-agents with.

fields.name: agent_types
fields.description: Optional parameter of `spawn` command. List of agent types for each ID (e.g., ['researcher', 'programmer']). If omitted or blank for an ID, the default general-purpose agent is used.

fields.name: tasks
fields.description: Required parameter of `delegate` command. Dictionary mapping sub-agent identifiers to task descriptions.

fields.name: file_path
fields.description: The path to the file to modify.

fields.name: old_string
fields.description: The text to replace. To create a new file, use an empty string. Must match the exact text in the file including whitespace.

fields.name: new_string
fields.description: The text to replace it with.

fields.name: expected_replacements
fields.description: Number of replacements expected. Defaults to 1. Use when you want to replace multiple occurrences. The edit will fail if the actual count doesn't match.

fields.name: command
fields.description: The commands to run. Allowed options are: `view`, `create`, `str_replace`, `insert`, `undo_edit`.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Absolute path to file or directory.

fields.name: file_text
fields.description: Required parameter of `create` command, with the content of the file to be created.

fields.name: old_str
fields.description: Required parameter of `str_replace` command containing the string in `path` to replace.

fields.name: new_str
fields.description: Optional parameter of `str_replace` command containing the new string (if not given, no string will be added). Required parameter of `insert` command containing the string to insert.

fields.name: insert_line
fields.description: Required parameter of `insert` command. The `new_str` will be inserted AFTER the line `insert_line` of `path`.

fields.name: view_range
fields.description: Optional parameter of `view` command when `path` points to a file. If none is given, the full file is shown. If provided, the file will be shown in the indicated line number range, e.g. [11, 12] will show lines 11 and 12. Indexing at 1 to start. Setting `[start_line, -1]` shows all lines from `start_line` to the end of the file.

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: The glob pattern to match files (e.g., "**/*.js", "src/**/*.ts")

fields.name: path
fields.description: The directory (absolute path) to search in. Defaults to the current working directory.

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: The regex pattern to search for in file contents

fields.name: path
fields.description: The directory (absolute path) to search in. Defaults to the current working directory.

fields.name: include
fields.description: Optional file pattern to filter which files to search (e.g., "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}")

fields.name: dir_path
fields.description: The path to the directory to list. Defaults to current directory.

fields.name: recursive
fields.description: Whether to list subdirectories recursively (up to 2 levels).

fields.name: path

fields.name: file_path
fields.description: The path to the file to read.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Optional: The 0-based line number to start reading from. Use for paginating through large files.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Optional: Maximum number of lines to read. Use with 'offset' to paginate through large files.

fields.name: description
fields.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: The task for the agent to perform.

fields.name: subagent_type
fields.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task.

fields.name: resume
fields.description: Task ID of the task to resume from.

fields.name: max_turns
fields.description: Deprecated: This field is ignored and will be removed in version 2. Maximum iterations are now determined by the agent definition or parent conversation.

fields.name: command
fields.description: The command to execute. `view` shows the current task list. `plan` creates or updates the task list based on provided requirements and progress. Always `view` the current list before making changes.

fields.name: task_list
fields.description: The full task list. Required parameter of `plan` command.

fields.name: command
fields.description: The shell command to execute. Can be empty string to view additional logs when the previous exit code is `-1`. Can be a special key name when `is_input` is True: `C-c` (Ctrl+C), `C-d` (Ctrl+D/EOF), `C-z` (Ctrl+Z), or any `C-<letter>` for Ctrl sequences; navigation keys `UP`, `DOWN`, `LEFT`, `RIGHT`, `HOME`, `END`, `PGUP`, `PGDN`; and `TAB`, `ESC`, `BS` (Backspace), `ENTER`. You can only execute one command at a time. Use the platform-appropriate shell syntax described in the tool description when chaining commands.

fields.name: is_input
fields.description: If True, the command is an input to the running process. If False, the command is executed in the terminal session. Default is False.

fields.name: timeout
fields.description: Optional. Sets a maximum time limit (in seconds) for running the command. If the command takes longer than this limit, you’ll be asked whether to continue or stop it. If you don’t set a value, the command will instead pause and ask for confirmation when it produces no new output for 30 seconds. Use a higher value if the command is expected to take a long time (like installation or testing), or if it has a known fixed duration (like sleep).

fields.name: reset
fields.description: If True, reset the terminal by creating a new session. Use this only when the terminal becomes unresponsive. Note that all previously set environment variables and session state will be lost after reset. Cannot be used with is_input=True.

fields.name: name
fields.description: A short name for this workflow run.

fields.name: script
fields.description: Python workflow script to run. It must define `async def main(wf):` and coordinate work only through the provided `wf` object.

fields.name: max_concurrency
fields.description: Maximum number of sub-agent tasks to run concurrently. Consider 2–4 for LLM-heavy workflows to avoid hitting API rate limits.

fields.name: file_path
fields.description: The path to the file to write to.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The content to write to the file.
